journey.name: recovery pin system back
journey.description:
On Payment Pending, after Retry original payment and Authorize retry, the system Back button on the payment PIN screen cancels the retry the same way the header Back does. The original payment stays pending, and a later Retry original payment reaches fee approval again without restarting the app. Before the fix the abandoned approval held the retry lock and every later retry stopped with Continue disabled.
Precondition: an onboarded funded dev wallet with PIN enabled and "Require PIN for payments" on, and Payment Pending showing "Retry original payment" for an on-chain send whose broadcast timed out. To get there, start an on-chain send to any regtest address and run `adb shell cmd connectivity airplane-mode enable` right after the swipe, so the broadcast cannot reach Electrum; turn airplane mode off again once Payment Pending shows the retry button. The app's Electrum server is the staging one, so stopping a local container does not fail the broadcast.
Android only: iOS has no system Back button, and its payment PIN screen answers "cancel" when it disappears by any route.

actions.action: Verify Payment Pending shows "Retry original payment" and record its transaction ID
Tap Retry original payment, keep the prefilled fee rate and tap Continue
Tap Authorize retry, accept any fee warnings, and verify the payment PIN screen appears
Press the system Back button (`adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_BACK`) without entering the PIN
Verify Payment Pending is shown again with the same transaction ID and "Retry original payment" enabled
Tap Retry original payment, keep the prefilled fee rate and tap Continue
Verify the fee approval step with "Authorize retry" appears within 10 seconds
Tap Cancel and verify Payment Pending still shows the same transaction ID
